name: icon-button
title: IconButton
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A round button holding one 24-grid stroke glyph. Use when an action is clear from its icon and space is tight.

dontUseWhen: the action needs a word to be understood
it is the primary action of a view
hairline.antiExampleWhy: No accessible name, and none of the system's sizing or tone tokens.

docs: The `label` prop is required — a button holding only a glyph is unreachable without an accessible name.
